name: cloudyai
description: Local-first AI copilot: on-device speech-to-text (CloudyVoice) + DeepSeek / opencode / commandcode answers in an overlay excluded from screen capture.
author: Tanay Mitra

scripts.test: node test/llm.test.js && node test/detection.test.js && node test/tray-icon.test.js && node test/pick.test.js && node test/overlay-render.test.js && node test/cloudyvoice-lifecycle.test.js
scripts.dist: npm run build:ear && npm run build:audio && electron-builder --mac --arm64

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: CloudyAI listens to the meeting audio so it can transcribe it on-device with CloudyVoice.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: CloudyAI needs screen access to capture system audio from calls.
